title: Símbolos nacionales
goal: Read how flags and anthems were actually made: a general who improvised a flag in 1812, and a national anthem chosen by public competition decades after independence.

items: Explain whether national symbols came from ancient, spontaneous tradition.
Describe who designed the Argentine flag and the traditional story about its colors.
Explain when and how the Mexican national anthem was created.
Explain how newly invented symbols came to feel permanent and natural.
Use passive voice and impersonal se to describe how national symbols were created and adopted.
